scopeOfAdvice.value: Ge'ez Consulting provides business advisory, coaching, and preparation support. Engagements are collaborative; you remain responsible for decisions and filings.

consultingVsRegulatedAdvice.value: Consulting and preparation help you organize questions, documents, and next steps. It is not a substitute for advice from a lawyer, tax professional, accountant/CPA, immigration consultant/lawyer, or other regulated advisor.

noGuaranteedOutcomes.value: We do not guarantee loans, grants, registrations, licenses, immigration results, tax outcomes, legal outcomes, revenue, or funding approvals.

notLegalTaxImmigrationAdvice.value: Information on this site and in consulting sessions is not legal, tax, accounting, or immigration advice. Consult a qualified professional for your situation.

notRegistryOrLicensingDecisions.value: Corporate registry filings, name approvals, municipal licences, and permits are decided by the relevant authorities—not by Ge'ez Consulting.

notFundingOrLenderDecisions.value: Banks, BDC, credit unions, grant programs, and other funders make their own credit and eligibility decisions. Preparation support does not promise approval.
